sections.name: RoomsPage
sections.title: Event Rooms home listing
sections.what: Shows the five sports as tiles. Each tile shows a count of recorded events, or a source-pending badge if there are none, and links to that sport's page.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets users see at a glance which sports have data.
sections.watch_out: A sport is marked pending only when its event list is empty, so a broken room feed would look the same as a missing licence.

summary: Home page of Event Rooms that lists the five sports and how many recorded match rooms each has.
purpose: The entry point to match rooms, so users pick a sport first.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the lead text, which says sports without a licensed source say so.
how: Steps in order: it loads the sport list. For each sport it asks the room service for its events. It shows a count, or a source-pending badge if there are none. Each sport links to its own page.
inputs: The sport list and the room data.
outputs: A list of five sport tiles.
risks: The display name table is repeated in three pages. A sport with no events shows as pending, which would also appear if the data feed broke.
debug: If a sport shows pending, check the room service's data for it. If a sport name is wrong, check the display name table.
